items.title: 11.3 Reaction mechanism and modes of bond breaking

source_refs.note: Topic 11.3 with Figures 11.5 and 11.6, printed pages 251-252.

blocks.text: Reaction mechanism is the series of steps that take place in the course of the overall reaction. Like all chemical reactions, organic reactions involve the breaking of chemical bonds. There are two ways in which covalent bonds can break.
